comments.text: In story writing, there was a really famous concept known as the bomb under the table. The idea is that if you were watching a scene of some people eating dinner at a kitchen table and a bomb went off all of a sudden, you would be shocked and surprised. But if you, as the audience, were shown the bomb beforehand and left the characters at the table unaware of its existence, you would introduce an element of suspense to the story. So the trade-off for the shocking moment of the explosion is all the tension that builds up leading to that final explosion. The audience knows something crazy is coming. They just don't know when. That being said, The Drake Bell cameo was peak.

comments.text:
Twilight Sparkle is the central main character of My Little Pony Friendship is Magic. She is a female unicorn pony who transforms into an Alicorn and becomes a princess in Magical Mystery Cure. She is also the daughter of Twilight Velvet and Night Light, the younger sister of Shining Armor, sister-in-law to Princess Cadance, and paternal aunt to Flurry Heart.

At the beginning of the series, Twilight and Spike move from their residence in Canterlot to the Golden Oak Library in Ponyville to study the magic of friendship, and in Twilight's Kingdom - Part 2, she gains her own castle along with the title "Princess of Friendship". She represents the element of magic.

Before becoming a princess, Twilight regularly sends friendship reports to Princess Celestia. In Owl's Well That Ends Well, she adopts a pet owl named Owlowiscious. As of The Last Problem, she is the ruler of Equestria.

Twilight's human counterpart, Sci-Twi, briefly serves as an antagonist in My Little Pony Equestria Girls: Friendship Games.
